verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Taa-seen-meem
Tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-mubeen
Natloo alayka min naba'i moosaa wa fir'awna bil-haqqi liqawmin yu'minoon
Inna fir'awna alaa fil-ardi wa ja'ala ahlahaa shiya'an yastad'ifu taa'ifatan minhum yudhabbihu abnaa'ahum wa yastahyee nisaa'ahum innahu kaana minal-mufsideen
Wa nureedu an namunna alal-ladheena ustud'ifoo fil-ardi wa naj'alahum a'immatan wa naj'alahumul-waaritheen
Wa numakkina lahum fil-ardi wa nuriya fir'awna wa haamaana wa junoodahumaa minhum maa kaanoo yahdharoon
Wa awhaynaa ilaa ummi moosaa an ardi'eehi fa-idhaa khifti alayhi fa-alqeehi fil-yammi wa laa takhaafee wa laa tahzanee innaa raaddoohu ilayki wa jaa'iloohu minal-mursaleen
Faltaqatahu aalu fir'awna liyakoona lahum aduwwan wa hazanan inna fir'awna wa haamaana wa junoodahumaa kaanoo khaati'een
Wa qaalat imra'atu fir'awna qurratu aynin lee wa laka laa taqtuloohu asaa an yanfa'anaa aw nattakhidhahu waladan wa hum laa yash'uroon
Wa asbaha fu'uaadu ummi moosaa faarighan in kaadat latubdee bihi lawlaa an rabatnaa alaa qalbihaa litakoona minal-mu'mineen
Wa qaalat li'khtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi an junubin wa hum laa yash'uroon
Wa harramnaa alayhil-maraadi'a min qablu faqaalat hal adullukum alaa ahli baytin yakfuloonahu lakum wa hum lahu naasihoon
Faradadnaahu ilaa ummihi kay taqarra aynuhaa wa laa tahzana wa lita'lama anna wa'da Allaahi haqqun wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wa lammaa balagha ashuddahu wastawaa aataynaahu hukman wa ilman wa kadhalika najzil-muhsineen

Wa dakhalal-madeenata alaa heeni ghaflatin min ahlihaa fawajada feehaa rajulayni yaqtatilaani haadhaa min shee'atihi wa haadhaa min aduwwihi fastaghaathahul-ladhee min shee'atihi alal-ladhee min aduwwihi fawakazahu moosaa faqadaa alayhi qaala haadhaa min amalish-shaytaani innahu aduwwun mudillun mubeen
Qaala rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Qaala rabbi bimaa an'amta alayya falan akoona zaheeran lilmujrimeen
Fa-asbaha fil-madeenati khaa'ifan yataraqqabu fa-idhal-ladhee istansarahu bil-amsi yastasrikhuhu qaala lahu moosaa innaka laghawiyyun mubeen

Falammaa an araada an yabtisha billadhee huwa aduwwun lahumaa qaala yaa moosaa atureedu an taqtulanee kamaa qatalta nafsan bil-amsi in tureedu illaa an takoona jabbaaran fil-ardi wa maa tureedu an takoona minal-musliheen
Wa jaa'a rajulun min aqsal-madeenati yas'aa qaala yaa moosaa innal-mala'a ya'tamiroona bika liyaqtulooka fakhruj innee laka minan-naasiheen
Fakharaja minhaa khaa'ifan yataraqqabu qaala rabbi najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa lammaa tawajjaha tilqaa'a madyana qaala asaa rabbee an yahdiyanee sawaa'as-sabeel

Wa lammaa warada maa'a madyana wajada alayhi ummatan minan-naasi yasqoona wa wajada min doonihimu imra'tayni tadhoodaani qaala maa khatbukumaa qaalataa laa nasqee hattaa yusdirar-ri'aa'u wa aboonaa shaykhun kabeer
Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawallaa ilaz-zilli faqaala rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
Fajaa'athu ihdaahumaa tamshee alas-tihyaa'in qaalat inna abee yad'ooka liyajziyaka ajra maa saqayta lanaa falammaa jaa'ahu wa qassa alayhil-qasasa qaala laa takhaf najawta minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Qaalat ihdaahumaa yaa abati ista'jirhu inna khayra manis-ta'jartal-qawiyyul-ameen

Qaala innee ureedu an unkihaka ihdab-natayya haatayni alaa an ta'juranee thamaaniyata hijajin fa-in atmamta ashran famin indika wa maa ureedu an ashuqqa alayka satajidunee in shaa'a Allaahu minas-saaliheen
Qaala dhaalika baynee wa baynaka ayyamal-ajalayni qadaytu falaa udwaana alayya Wallaahu alaa maa naqoolu wakeel

Falammaa qadaa moosal-ajala wa saara bi-ahlihi aanasa min jaanibit-toori naaran qaala li'hlihi umkuthoo innee aanastu naaran la-allee aateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw jadhwatin minan-naari la-allakum tastaloon
Falammaa ataahaa noodee min shaati'il-waadil-aymani fil-buq'atil-mubaarakati minash-shajarati an yaa moosaa innee anaa Allaahu rabbul-aalameen
Wa an alqi asaaka falammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu ka'annahaa jaannun wallaa mudbiran wa lam yu'aqqib yaa moosaa aqbil wa laa takhaf innaka minal-aamineen
Usluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo'in wadmum ilayka janaahaka minar-rahbi fadhaanika burhaanaani min rabbika ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihi innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
Qaala rabbi innee qataltu minhum nafsan fa-akhaafu an yaqtuloon
Wa akhee haaroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisaanan fa-arsilhu ma'iya rid'an yusaddiqunee innee akhaafu an yukadhdhiboon
Qaala sanashuddu adudaka bi-akheeka wa naj'alu lakumaa sultaanan falaa yasiloona ilaykumaa bi-aayaatinaa antumaa wa manit-taba'akumal-ghaaliboon
Falammaa jaa'ahum moosaa bi-aayaatinaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa sihrun muftaran wa maa sami'naa bihadhaa fee aabaa'inal-awwaleen
Wa qaala moosaa rabbee a'lamu biman jaa'a bil-hudaa min indihi wa man takoonu lahu aaqibatud-daari innahu laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon

Wa qaala fir'awnu yaa ayyuhal-mala'u maa alimtu lakum min ilaahin ghayree fa-awqid lee yaa haamaanu alat-teeni faaj'al lee sarhan la-allee attali'u ilaa ilaahi moosaa wa innee la-azunnuhu minal-kaadhibeen
Wastakbara huwa wa junooduhu fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wa zannoo annahum ilaynaa laa yurja'oon
Fa-akhadhnaahu wa junoodahu fanabadhnaahum fil-yammi fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatuz-zaalimeen
Wa ja'alnaahum a'immatan yad'oona ilan-naari wa yawmal-qiyaamati laa yunsaroon
Wa atba'naahum fee haadhihid-dunyaa la'natan wa yawmal-qiyaamati hum minal-maqbooheen
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba min ba'di maa ahlaknal-quroonal-oolaa basaa'ira lin-naasi wa hudan wa rahmatan la-allahum yatadhakkaroon
Wa maa kunta bijaanibil-gharbiyyi idh qadaynaa ilaa moosal-amra wa maa kunta minash-shaahideen
Wa laakinnaa ansha'naa quroonan fatataawala alayhimul-umuru wa maa kunta thaaweean fee ahli madyana tatloo alayhim aayaatinaa wa laakinnaa kunnaa mursileen
Wa maa kunta bijaanibit-toori idh naadaynaa wa laakin rahmatan min rabbika litundhira qawman maa ataahum min nadheerin min qablika la-allahum yatadhakkaroon
Wa lawlaa an tuseebahum museebatun bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbanaa lawlaa arsalta ilaynaa rasoolan fanattabi'a aayaatika wa nakoona minal-mu'mineen
Falammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu min indinaa qaaloo lawlaa ootiya mithla maa ootiya moosaa awalam yakfuroo bimaa ootiya moosaa min qablu qaaloo sihraani tazaaharaa wa qaaloo innaa bikullin kaafiroon
Qul fa'too bikitaabin min indi Allaahi huwa ahdaa minhumaa attabi'hu in kuntum saadiqeen
Fa-in lam yastajeeboo laka fa'lam annamaa yattabi'oona ahwaa'ahum wa man adallu mimmani ittaba'a hawaahu bighayri hudan mina Allaahi innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Wa laqad wassalnaa lahumul-qawla la-allahum yatadhakkaroon
Al-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba min qablihi hum bihi yu'minoon
Wa idhaa yutlaa alayhim qaaloo aamannaa bihi innahul-haqqu min rabbinaa innaa kunnaa min qablihi muslimeen
Ulaa'ika yu'tawna ajrahum marratayni bimaa sabaroo wa yadra'oona bil-hasanatis-sayyi'ata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wa idhaa sami'ul-laghwa a'radoo anhu wa qaaloo lanaa a'maalunaa wa lakum a'maalukum salaamun alaykum laa nabtaghil-jaahileen
Innaka laa tahdee man ahbabta wa laakinna Allaaha yahdee man yashaa'u wa huwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
Wa qaaloo in nattabi'il-hudaa ma'aka nutakhattaf min ardinaa awalam numakkin lahum haraman aaminan yujbaa ilayhi thamaraatu kulli shay'in rizqan min ladunnaa wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wa kam ahlaknaa min qaryatin batirat ma'eeshatahaa fatilka masaakinuhum lam tuskan min ba'dihim illaa qaleelan wa kunnaa nahnul-waaritheen
Wa maa kaana rabbuka muhlikal-quraa hattaa yab'atha fee ummihaa rasoolan yatloo alayhim aayaatinaa wa maa kunnaa muhlikil-quraa illaa wa ahluhaa zaalimoon
Wa maa ooteetum min shay'in famataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa wa zeenatuhaa wa maa indallaahi khayrun wa abqaa afalaa ta'qiloon
Afaman wa-adnaahu wa'dan hasanan fahuwa laaqeehi kaman matta'naahu mataa'al-hayaatid-dunyaa thumma huwa yawmal-qiyaamati minal-muhdareen
Wa yawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum taz'umoon
Qaalal-ladheena haqqa alayhimul-qawlu rabbanaa haa'ulaa'il-ladheena aghwaynaa aghwaynaahum kamaa ghawaynaa tabarra'naa ilayka maa kaanoo iyyaanaa ya'budoon
Wa qeelad-oo shurakaa'akum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wa ra'aw al-adhaaba law annahum kaanoo yahtadoon
Wa yawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu maadhaa ajabtumul-mursaleen
Fa-amiyat alayhimul-anbaa'u yawma'idhin fahum laa yatasaa'aloon
Fa-ammaa man taaba wa aamana wa amila saalihan fa-asaa an yakoona minal-mufliheen
Wa rabbuka yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wa yakhtaaru maa kaana lahumul-khiyaratu subhaanallaahi wa ta'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Wa rabbuka ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wa maa yu'linoon
Wa huwallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa lahul-hamdu fil-oolaa wal-aakhirati wa lahul-hukmu wa ilayhi turja'oon
Qul ara'aytum in ja'ala Allaahu alaykumul-layla sarmadan ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man ilaahun ghayru Allaahi ya'teekum bidiyaa'in afalaa tasma'oon
Qul ara'aytum in ja'ala Allaahu alaykumun-nahaara sarmadan ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man ilaahun ghayru Allaahi ya'teekum bilaylin taskunoona feehi afalaa tubsiroon
Wa min rahmatihi ja'ala lakumul-layla wan-nahaara litaskunoo feehi wa litabtaghoo min fadlihi wa la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa yawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum taz'umoon
Wa naza'naa min kulli ummatin shaheedan faqulnaa haatoo burhaanakum fa-alimoo annal-haqqa Lillaahi wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon

Inna qaaroona kaana min qawmi moosaa fabaghaa alayhim wa aataynaahu minal-kunoozi maa inna mafaatihahu latanoo'u bil-usbati ulil-quwwati idh qaala lahu qawmuhu laa tafrah innallaaha laa yuhibbul-fariheen
Wabtaghi feemaa aataaka Allaahud-daaral-aakhirata wa laa tansa naseebaka minad-dunyaa wa ahsin kamaa ahsana Allaahu ilayka wa laa tabghil-fasaada fil-ardi innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mufsideen
Qaala innamaa ooteetuhu alaa ilmin indee awalam ya'lam annallaaha qad ahlaka min qablihi minal-qurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatan wa aktharu jam'an wa laa yus'alu an dhunoobihimul-mujrimoon
Fakharaja alaa qawmihi fee zeenatihi qaalal-ladheena yureedoonal-hayaatad-dunyaa yaalayta lanaa mithla maa ootiya qaaroonu innahu ladhoo hazzin azeem
Wa qaalal-ladheena ootul-ilma waylakum thawaabu Allaahi khayrun liman aamana wa amila saalihan wa laa yulaqqaahaa illas-saabiroon
Fakhasafnaa bihi wa bidaarihil-arda famaa kaana lahu min fi'atin yansuroonahu min doonillaahi wa maa kaana minal-muntasireen

Wa asbahal-ladheena tamannaw makaanahu bil-amsi yaqooloona wayka'anna Allaaha yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u min ibaadihi wa yaqdiru lawlaa an manna Allaahu alaynaa lakhasafa binaa wayka'annahu laa yuflihul-kaafiroon
Tilkad-daarul-aakhiratu naj'aluhaa lilladheena laa yureedoona uluwwan fil-ardi wa laa fasaadan wal-aaqibatu lilmuttaqeen
Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahu khayrun minhaa wa man jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati falaa yujzal-ladheena amilus-sayyi'aati illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Innal-ladhee farada alaykal-qur'aana laraadduka ilaa ma'aadin qul rabbee a'lamu man jaa'a bil-hudaa wa man huwa fee dalaalin mubeen
Wa maa kunta tarjoo an yulqaa ilaykal-kitaabu illaa rahmatan min rabbika falaa takoonanna zaheeran lilkaafireen
Wa laa yasuddunnaka an aayaati Allaahi ba'da idh unzilat ilayka wad'u ilaa rabbika wa laa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
Wa laa tad'u ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara laa ilaaha illaa huwa kullu shay'in haalikun illaa wajhahu lahul-hukmu wa ilayhi turja'oon
